source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Eligibility needs all three: the unit is aboard a **TRANSPORT** model on the battlefield, it did not get in this phase, and that **TRANSPORT** has made neither an advance nor a fall-back move in this phase. The unit is placed per Set Up (03.02), each model wholly inside the set-up distance from the **TRANSPORT**: 3" for Rapid or Tactical, 6" for Combat. Before placing, choose the mode. Rapid must be used if the **TRANSPORT** made a normal move or an ingress move during the phase. Failing that, Tactical must be used when the **TRANSPORT** remained stationary or is still unselected for movement this phase and the unit can be placed as required. Otherwise the mode is Combat, and each model in the unit takes a hazard roll. Rapid: in a turn when the **TRANSPORT** arrived by ingress move, each model is bound by whatever rules bound the **TRANSPORT** during that move; afterwards the unit may not declare a charge for the rest of the turn. Tactical: afterwards, select the unit to make either a normal move or an advance move. Combat: models may be placed engaged with enemy units that the **TRANSPORT** is engaged with; afterwards the unit becomes battle-shocked and may not declare a charge for the rest of the turn.
